supersession_reason: The v1 plan listed path-filtered Documentation and Auditor Closure workflows as global required status checks. A provider-global required check must be able to spawn for every pull request targeting main; otherwise an unrelated pull request can be blocked by a check that never exists.

required_status_checks_global.context: CI / Test, lint and assemble devDebug
Human Impact Cross-Repo Gate V1 / validate-human-impact-contract

candidate_ready_checks.reason: The job is intentionally gated by pull_request.draft == false. Preserve it as a ready-for-review gate instead of making it a provider-global context that may be absent/skipped for draft lifecycle states.

specialized_conditional_checks.reason: The workflow is intentionally triggered only for auditor-closure contract/evidence surfaces.
The workflow is intentionally triggered only for documentation/Markdown/documentation-contract surfaces.

workflow_scope_invariants: A provider-global required status check MUST spawn for every pull request targeting main.
A workflow with pull_request paths or paths-ignore filtering MUST NOT be configured as a provider-global required status check.
A job intentionally skipped for draft lifecycle state MUST NOT be treated as an unconditional provider-global required context.
Conditional specialized gates remain enforced by their own workflow trigger contract when applicable.

negative_assurance_test.method: Use a bounded PR/fixture with one globally required check deliberately failing or the required review absent and observe provider refusal to merge without bypass.
negative_assurance_test.failure: provider permits merge despite required failure or absent required review

application_sequence: Re-read canonical main SHA and current provider protection/ruleset state.
Require an Administration:write-capable authorized surface and a rollback capsule before mutation.
Apply this v2 policy or an explicitly equivalent/stronger provider policy using only global contexts listed in required_status_checks_global.
Immediately re-read provider state and bind exact protection/ruleset identifiers.
Exercise the bounded negative merge-rejection test.
Append a successor receipt; never rewrite this prepared plan.
exit_criteria: authorized administrative surface applies equivalent or stronger provider policy
provider readback proves enforcement on canonical main
all provider-global required checks are bound and universally spawn-capable
review and conversation-resolution requirements are observable
force-push and deletion blocks are observable
bounded negative assurance proves provider rejection without bypass
successor receipt records exact provider policy identifiers and observed repository revision
